description: Given a 2D matrix, handle queries to calculate the sum of elements inside the rectangle defined by its upper left corner (row1, col1) and lower right corner (row2, col2).
intuition: Extend 1D prefix sums to 2D using inclusion-exclusion. Each prefix cell stores the sum of the entire rectangle from the origin. To get any sub-rectangle, add and subtract the right corners - like a Venn diagram for rectangles.
approach: Precompute a 2D prefix sum matrix. The sum of a rectangle can be computed using inclusion-exclusion in O(1) per query.
jsWalkthrough:
Example: matrix = [[3,0,1,4],[5,6,3,2],[1,2,0,1]]
prefix[2][3] = sum of matrix[0..1][0..2] = 3+0+1+5+6+3 = 18

sumRegion(1,1,2,2):
  bottomRight = prefix[3][3], topPart = prefix[1][3]
  leftPart = prefix[3][1], topLeft = prefix[1][1]
  = (3+0+1+5+6+3+1+2+0) - (3+0+1) - (3+5+1) - (3)
  = 21 - 4 - 9 + 3 = 11... (use actual values for exact trace)
explanation:
1. Build 2D prefix sum where prefix[i][j] = sum of matrix[0..i-1][0..j-1].
2. Use inclusion-exclusion: sum of rectangle = prefix[r2+1][c2+1] - prefix[r1][c2+1] - prefix[r2+1][c1] + prefix[r1][c1].
3. Each query is O(1) after O(m*n) preprocessing.
hints: prefix[i][j] = sum of all elements in the submatrix from (0,0) to (i-1,j-1).
Use inclusion-exclusion to compute any rectangular sum.
